title: Rotate String Check
description: Given two lowercase strings `s` and `goal`, return `true` if and only if `s` can become `goal` after some number of left shifts (possibly zero). A single left shift moves the leftmost character of `s` to the rightmost position.
constraints: s and goal consist of lowercase English letters.
hints: Two strings of different lengths can never be rotations of each other.
Every rotation of s appears as a contiguous substring of s + s.
